couplet.zh: 秦月照研路，罗星汇万象
couplet.en: The Qin moon lights the path of inquiry; the Luo stars gather all phenomena.

mission.zh: 「秦罗万象」由秦勇（Yong Qin）与罗朝广（Chaoguang Luo）两位学者共同组成。我们以严谨、开放、可复现的方法开展学术研究，关注管理与数据科学交叉领域的真实问题，并在此记录与分享团队的研究进展与思考。
mission.en: Aethera is formed by two scholars, Yong Qin and Chaoguang Luo. We pursue rigorous, open, and reproducible research on real-world questions at the intersection of management and data science, and we share our progress and reflections here.

mission.zh:
面向真实世界的科学问题，
以求真为志，以协作为径。
mission.en: Pursuing scientific questions grounded in the real world, with truth-seeking as our aim and collaboration as our path.

text.zh: 数据科学、决策支持与智能推荐等交叉方向。
text.en: Intersections of data science, decision support, and intelligent recommendation.
